# 维修检查与故障排除

_Inspection & Troubleshooting_

FAA 动力装置教材第 10 章提供发动机维护与运行的学习入口。整理时可按检查对象、异常现象、证据和处理记录建立索引。

_Chapter 10 of the FAA powerplant handbook is an entry point for studying engine maintenance and operation. Organise references by inspection target, symptom, evidence and action record._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 把检查方法、发现现象和判断依据分开写，避免只有一个故障结论。

_Separate inspection methods, observations and reasoning rather than recording only a fault conclusion._

- 记录工况、使用经历和复检结果，关联状态监测资料。

_Record operating conditions, service history and reinspection results, linking them to condition-monitoring information._

- 本条目不替代具体型号的批准维修文件或现场放行程序。

_This entry does not replace approved maintenance data for a specific type or an operational release procedure._
